mara_pm: Vendor just tightened the MI300 image requirements. New firmware blob + kernel module needed. Also a B200 SKU shows thermal derate at sustained load. Need to lock marketplace gating and SI soak plan ASAP.

igor_vendor: Confirmed. MI300 requires fw-2.2.0 and module km-1.4. B200 SKU B200-P shows derate above 660W; fw-2.2.0 candidate reduces temp ~5C in vendor lab. Will upload artifacts.

sachin_eng: Please upload minimal repro logs and the fw SHA. We'll update our image builder to include km-1.4 and add CI gates. Proposed tag: `redwood/mkt/{vendor}/{sku}/fw-{sha}`.

zoe_market: Marketplace rule: cannot unlock SKU rows without signed image SHA + declared regions + legal-approved partner blurb. Marketing needs 7 business days after final artifacts.

faye_si: SI asks: provide fw blob + SHA, integration checklist, and a 48h soak across US-EAST and EU-WEST. Acceptance: temp < 82C and perf_drop <= 8%.

cal-bot: mara_pm scheduled "MI300/B200 marketplace handoff" on 2025-03-28 09:00 PT with mara_pm, igor_vendor, sachin_eng, zoe_market, faye_si. Invite sent.

mara_pm: Actions before sync:
- igor_vendor: upload fw-2.2.0 + module + SKU delta (due: EOD tomorrow)
- sachin_eng: CI gating PR + image tag docs (due: +48h)
- faye_si: SI soak template + rollback stub (due: +48h)
- zoe_market: embargo draft + legal loop (due: sync)

igor_vendor: Will deliver. If partner lab finds regressions we may delay GA by up to 14 days and will update here.

sachin_eng: I'll sketch fallback routing: route affected workloads to H100 variant with reduced batch sizes if SI fails post-release.

mara_pm: Good. Post blockers here. If nothing changes we'll triage in the meeting. :thumbsup:
